explanation.what: A container that groups related Azure resources.
explanation.why: Keeps every resource for this app together so it can be managed, secured and removed as one unit.
Gives the server a private address so it is not exposed directly to the internet.

explanation.what: A section of the network reserved for the Application Gateway.
explanation.why: Keeps the gateway separate from the server so each can have its own rules.

explanation.what: A section of the network for the application server.
explanation.why: Holds the server on a private address range with its own security rules.

explanation.what: A set of firewall rules for a subnet.
explanation.why: Only lets traffic from the gateway reach the server.
The gateway needs one so users can reach the app. The server itself stays private.

explanation.what: A web traffic load balancer that receives user requests.
explanation.why: It is the only public entry point and forwards requests to the private server.

explanation.what: A virtual server that runs the application.
explanation.why: Runs your app on a private address, reachable only through the gateway.

explanation.what: Grants a group permission on a set of resources.
explanation.why: Gives your operators access with only the rights they need.
